{{Quote|I'll just be a moment. Someone will be right here with you.|The nurse leaves Faiza in a hospital corridor|audio=Nurse-RightHere-MIS.flac|<ref name="MIS" />}}
A [[Color|brown]]-[[hair]]ed [[human]] with light skin worked as a '''nurse''' at [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on<ref name="MIS" /> the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="CGttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="MIS" /> she cared for the patient<ref name="MISAD" /> [[Faiza]]<ref name="DB">{{Databank|faiza-granny|Faiza (“Granny”)}}</ref> and pushed her through one of the [[Medcenter|hospital's]] corridors in a<ref name="MIS" /> [[med-glide wheelchair]].<ref name="MISAD" /> Promising to only be gone a moment and that someone else would be with Faiza shortly, the [[nurse]] left the patient in the corridor and moved into a side room. [[Kleya Marki]], a rebel member of the [[Axis network]] who was disguised in the same, yellow, [[Color|blue]]-striped [[Clothing|uniform]] as the nurse, then began pushing Faiza's wheelchair, using the patient to infiltrate higher into the hospital so that she could [[Death|kill]] her [[Prisoner|captive]] fellow rebel [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="MIS" /> After his death, the entire hospital was locked down by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="WEK">{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The nurse appeared in "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']],<ref name="MIS" /> which aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
